title: t27c on golden_sieve.t27 -- the ternary sieve, native
desc: t27c on the t27c lab (Railway), spec at t27 5ff0ec512: 3 tests pass natively; allowing a third trit trips a compile-time invariant and blocks the spec; letting S5 admit shift registers fails exactly one test; git restores the spec.
commands: t27c gen specs/numeric/golden_sieve.t27 > golden_sieve.zig && zig test golden_sieve.zig
sed -i 's/^pub const MAX_TRITS : u32 = 2;/pub const MAX_TRITS : u32 = 3;/' specs/numeric/golden_sieve.t27 && git diff -U0 | tail -n 2
git checkout specs/numeric/golden_sieve.t27 && sed -i 's/^    return srl_count == 0;/    return true;/' specs/numeric/golden_sieve.t27 && git diff -U0 | tail -n 2
